notes: The DMV is ONE city stitched from many independent jurisdictions across 3 states. Each parcel carries a `jurisdiction` column (set directly in run_dmv.py), driving a Houston-style region toggle that switches by jurisdiction. Value-bearing jurisdictions with open assessed land/improvement data: DC (Owner Polygons), Montgomery + Prince George's (MD SDAT statewide MD_ParcelBoundaries), Fairfax County, Arlington County, City of Fairfax. (Alexandria, Falls Church, Loudoun, Prince William withhold dollar values from open GIS — pending a CAMA extract.) Local-dev only: never listed in the picker, and on any deployed host (prod OR dev.civicmapper.org) `?city=dmv` falls back to the default. Reachable only on localhost. Region toggle switches by jurisdiction (city/county), like Houston's Municipal Jurisdiction group. The `jurisdiction` column is in H3_CATEGORICAL_FIELDS so the bake emits metadata.groups. WMATA Metrorail overlay (lines colored by route + station markers), toggled on the map.
